purpose: Describe a situation filled entirely with one kind of thing.
keywords: Today was a day full of good things.
Someone dressed entirely in black arrived.
This proposal seems to have nothing but advantages.
restrictions: Common with positive events and fixed combinations such as 黒ずくめ.
mistake: Unlike まみれ, it need not describe physical dirt; combinations are limited.
